name: Goodwood, draft
status: DRAFT, phase 1 (the course plan), 17 Nov 2026: not used by the game or the race view yet
_about: Built by tools/course/goodwood/layout.py from OpenStreetMap's outline of the course (reference/goodwood/osm-goodwood.json; map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) and the ground's heights (reference/goodwood/dem-course-20m.json, AWS Terrain Tiles). Don't edit by hand: change the choices at the top of the script.
axes: As Ascot: origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the home straight the horses run towards -x. RIGHT-handed: each route's rail (z = 0) is on the horses' right in that route's running direction, the track runs to z = +trackWidth on their left; on the home straight the stands are beyond (z > trackWidth, south).

routesNote: Each route is its rail sampled every 'spacing' metres, from d0 (metres to go, negative = the run-out past the post) back to its far end; 'bends' for the race engine as [metres to go at the start, at the end, degrees turned (positive = right, towards the rail)]; 'heights' the ground along it. straight: 5f, 6f. lower: 7f, 1m, down the east leg and into the straight by the lower bend (the west branch). diagonal: 9f, 9f192y, from the chute's corner down the diagonal and the lower bend. chute: 1m3f, 1m4f, round the top of the loop, down the east leg, the top bend (the east branch). loop: 1m6f, 2m, up the west branch, once round, the top bend. cup: 2m4f, 2m5f, east along the straight from by the post first.
